config.name: Edits per minute
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS "edits/min"
FROM dfe.`wikipedia-recentchanges`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Bot and human changes
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       if(dynamicType(_json.bot) = 'None', 'human', 'bot') AS who,
       count() AS changes
FROM dfe.`wikipedia-recentchanges`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, who
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Top pages (edits and new pages)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toString(_json.title) AS "Page",
       count() AS "Changes",
       uniqExact(toString(_json.user)) AS "Editors"
FROM dfe.`wikipedia-recentchanges`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND toString(_json.type) IN ('edit', 'new')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 12

config.name: Wikis and change types
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toString(_json._dfe_fetcher_wiki) AS "Wiki",
       toString(_json.type) AS "Type",
       count() AS "Changes"
FROM dfe.`wikipedia-recentchanges`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

config.name: Size change distribution (bytes)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT multiIf(d < -2000, 'shrank over 2000', d < -200, 'shrank 200 to 2000', d < 0, 'shrank under 200', d = 0, 'no change', d <= 200, 'grew under 200', d <= 2000, 'grew 200 to 2000', 'grew over 2000') AS "Change",
       count() AS "Edits"
FROM (SELECT toInt64OrZero(toString(_json.newlen)) - toInt64OrZero(toString(_json.oldlen)) AS d FROM dfe.`wikipedia-recentchanges` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND toString(_json.type) = 'edit')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY min(d)
